provenance.unrecovered_source_note: The original Sol 24-finding machine-readable register was not present in surviving branch history and the referenced orphan commit could not be resolved. This file is a reconstruction from surviving audit prose, current source, PR #55 commits, CI evidence, and adversarial reachability checks. It must not be represented as byte-for-byte or item-for-item identical to the lost source.
provenance.reconstruction_rule: A finding appears here only when current repository evidence supports its state. Newly discovered findings are included even when they may not have been in the original 24.

state_vocabulary.CLOSED: Repository implementation and regression evidence exist on the closure branch.
state_vocabulary.OPEN: Repository-side implementation remains incomplete or unsafe.
state_vocabulary.EXTERNAL_GATE: Repository-side implementation is present enough to fail closed, but live/device/provider evidence is still required.
state_vocabulary.SUPERSEDED: Earlier finding was replaced by a more accurate current finding.

findings.title: Canonical Rev 5.1 tree was dropped by later Commander merge
findings.acceptance: Canonical sentinels are present and CI includes the tree-regression guard.

findings.title: Commander authorization trusted caller-provided requested_by identity
findings.acceptance: Gateway/Hermes Commander credentials are distinct and requested_by cannot mint credential-bearing authority.

findings.title: Captured third-party notification/share content had no safe production consumer
findings.acceptance: CONTEXT_INGEST is hardware-proofed, untrusted, authority NONE, and never routed through /v1/commands.

findings.title: Generic Android replay deleted durable SESSION_ENVELOPE before session restoration
findings.acceptance: Generic replayer leaves SESSION_ENVELOPE to VanHermesSessionManager and removes it only through the session consumer.

findings.title: Hermes execution had no deterministic result-to-Mission reconciliation path
findings.acceptance: Hermes reports lifecycle by bound run id; COMPLETED enters gateway verification and Hermes cannot assert VERIFIED_SUCCESS.

findings.title: Full Desktop Commander inherited VM-admin identity
Recovery control was broader than bounded recovery purpose
SPMRF/ChatGPT reviewer inherited VM-admin identity/home permissions
Gateway and Hermes Commander environment/credential binding was ambiguous
Privileged recovery diagnostics could expose sensitive runtime detail
Owner had no deterministic offline reconfirmation surface
Hermes Google capabilities existed but common read-only Workspace functions were not exposed through typed MCP
findings.acceptance: Gmail search, agenda, Drive search, contacts, tasks, status/capabilities and deterministic job planning are exposed; raw mutations are not.

findings.title: Wake-word runtime cannot arm even with an admitted wake asset
findings.detail: WakeModelLoader now constructs a real pinned sherpa-onnx KWS pipeline from a checksum-admitted bundle and fails closed on missing/invalid/JNI-unavailable assets. Physical-device/model qualification remains an external gate.

findings.title: Browser Harness private worker service is absent
findings.detail: A real loopback Browser Harness worker, pinned dependency, systemd unit and bootstrap health gate now exist. Live Trading Core qualification remains external.

findings.title: Stagehand private semantic worker service is absent
findings.detail: Stagehand semantic tiers now run through a private worker one observed action at a time under BrowserSubagentRunner; direct Stagehand agent loops are refused.

findings.title: Google mutation routes still accept caller-provided approval booleans outside Action Runtime
findings.detail: Gmail draft/send and Calendar reschedule now require an Action Runtime execution bound to signed owner authority; the HTTP/MCP execution path has no approval boolean and each mutation performs provider read-back before VERIFIED_SUCCESS.

findings.title: Notification/share ingest producer and gateway schemas drifted
findings.acceptance: Context IDs are stable; notification mapping converts Android fields into gateway intelligence input and share remains untrusted.

findings.title: New context data audit label was outside explicit audit namespace contract
Wake/voice physical-device behavior is not certified on target S24
Remaining non-Workspace Google provider capabilities are not all live-certified
findings.detail: Workspace OAuth itself is already live-certified READY: permanent Desktop OAuth consent is installed, the refresh credential is encrypted, and Gmail/Calendar/Drive/Contacts/Tasks canaries returned HTTP 200. This external gate is intentionally narrower: Gemini/consumer/cloud and other provider capabilities retain their own READY, CAPACITY_LIMITED, CONFIGURED or EXTERNAL states and require per-capability live evidence before promotion.

findings.title: Current end-to-end automation fabric requires live re-certification after later gateway integration changes
findings.detail: The self-hosted Trading Core n8n runtime was live-certified GREEN on 2026-09-18 with n8n 2.39.7, task runner/PostgreSQL healthy and required_failures=0. Later gateway-side automation routing, execution, standing-authority, health and verification changes landed after that host attestation. The remaining gate is current-head end-to-end live re-qualification, not proof that the n8n runtime never worked. The qualification instrument now additionally requires VAN_EXPECTED_REPOSITORY_SHA and refuses a dirty or different deployed checkout, so the next live evidence can be bound to the exact canonical main commit.

findings.title: VATI live broker path remains outside repository-only certification
Authenticated browser profile persistence/readback not live-certified
Rive embodiment asset/runtime remains externally supplied where native fallback is used
Production Cloudflare authenticated ingress is not certified by quick-tunnel evidence
Hermes live runtime/profile registration must be re-qualified after MCP surface changes
Local second-pass ASR existed only as an interface
findings.detail: A checksum-confined sherpa offline transducer now implements LocalSecondPassAsr and is injected into VoiceInputManager when provisioned; absence falls back to the first pass without simulated confidence.

findings.title: Speaker evidence was not production-reachable at the authoritative action class
findings.detail: Android now measures and signs fixed-point speaker provenance in v3; the gateway enforces it only after deterministic action resolution. It can tighten authority but cannot replace A4 biometric approval.

findings.title: Wake listener did not re-arm after a completed wake-originated command turn
findings.detail: STT final/error callbacks re-arm only the active wake-originated turn; manual voice turns cannot enable background listening.

findings.title: Trading Core runtime qualification could certify a stale or locally modified checkout without binding evidence to the externally selected repository SHA
findings.acceptance: Qualification now fails unless a clean deployed checkout exactly matches VAN_EXPECTED_REPOSITORY_SHA; the report records observed and expected SHA, and rebuild resolves the branch once before provisioning so a moving ref cannot silently change the certified revision.
findings.detail: Repository closure and runtime qualification are separate claims. This guard makes later Trading Core live evidence causally attributable to a specific canonical commit rather than to whatever checkout happens to be installed.

findings.title: Trading Core rebuild resolved a certification SHA but still deployed a moving branch rather than that exact revision
findings.acceptance: The externally resolved 40-hex revision is now the revision actually checked out for both first-boot installer source and /opt/van-trading/app; bootstrap rejects malformed revision pins before provisioning, and qualification still independently verifies exact clean HEAD equality.
findings.detail: REC-P1-015 made stale/mutated runtime evidence fail closed, but provisioning could still race a moving branch and fail nondeterministically after the external SHA had been selected. Exact-SHA deployment removes that race instead of merely detecting it after installation.

closure_summary.reason: All reconstructed and newly discovered repository-side findings are closed, including exact-SHA Trading Core deployment pinning discovered during post-merge audit. External/device/runtime gates remain separate. Full PR-head CI run 35621632137 passed on 90756a06e5f6a26be2ad11a9a25afa8dcdf76271; canonical-main van-ci run 35622699643 passed after PR #55. PR #57 carries the post-merge deterministic deployment hardening and must pass full head CI before merge.

post_merge_reconciliation.certification_scope: Full CI was green on both the PR #55 certified implementation head and the resulting canonical main merge commit. Runtime, provider, device and live-environment gates remain independently evidence-gated.
